prompt:
Work from the styled table shown in the image: a card-style table with one Name column, several numeric columns, a rounded outer frame, and a shaded header row. Answer this question. Using only the rows with values in Dist from 19 to 21 inclusive, determine the mean of the Mass column.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence requirement: set "evidence" to an array containing the ordered supporting cell pairs [filter cell, target cell] for each selected row in top-to-bottom row order.
Answer format: set "answer" to the exact integer filtered summary value.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236],[260,236,372,292],[374,236,486,292]],"answer":14}
